title: Capsule toy machine
prompt: a Japanese gashapon capsule toy machine: insert coins, turn the knob, a capsule drops and you open it; see-through shows the coin mechanism, agitator wheel, capsule gate and chute
blurb: Two 100 yen coins lift the lock pawl, one turn of the knob swings the agitator wheel a quarter turn over the gate, and a capsule rolls down the chute to the flap.
